description: Suite de non-regression des ROUTINES (manifest D15, scripts, daemon resident, citations)

tests.commande: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open(r'{racine}/cerveau-projet/freelance/routines/manifest.json', encoding='utf-8')); assert len(m.get('routines_surveillance', [])) >= 4; print('MANIFEST OK')"

python3 -c "import json,os; m=json.load(open(r'{racine}/cerveau-projet/freelance/routines/manifest.json', encoding='utf-8')); base=r'{racine}/cerveau-projet/freelance/routines'; absents=[r['script'] for r in m['routines_surveillance'] if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(base, r['script'].replace('/', os.sep)))]; assert not absents, 'absents: %s' % absents; print('SCRIPTS OK')"

python3 -c "import os,ctypes; pid=int(open(r'{racine}/cerveau-projet/freelance/tools-commun/jarvis/routines-server.pid').read().strip()); k=ctypes.windll.kernel32; h=k.OpenProcess(0x1000, False, pid); assert h, 'daemon %d mort' % pid; k.CloseHandle(h); print('DAEMON VIVANT', pid)"
python3 -c "import json; e=json.load(open(r'{racine}/cerveau-projet/freelance/routines/etat-executions.json', encoding='utf-8')); assert e; print('ETAT OK')"
